hyperparameter_config_a_desc: Hyperparameter configuration includes learning rate, momentum, regularization, etc., which are used to optimize the model training process.
hyperparameter_config_b_desc: Batch Size Parameter Description: This parameter specifies the number of samples used before the model updates its weights.
hyperparameter_config_c_desc: Group Size Parameter Description: This parameter defines the number of elements contained in each group; proper configuration can optimize system performance and resource allocation, with recommended values depending on specific scenarios.
hyperparameter_config_d_desc: Training Epochs Parameter Description: This refers to the number of times the model trains on the complete dataset, which affects model convergence and overfitting risk.
advanced_config_a_desc: Hyperparameter configuration includes learning rate, momentum, regularization, etc., which are used to optimize the model training process.
advanced_config_b_desc: Max Prompt Length is set to 50 characters to ensure that the text input to the model is not too long, which could affect model processing efficiency and performance.

advanced_config_d: Number of Samples per Parameter Update
advanced_config_d_desc: The number of samples per parameter update requires a 50-character detailed description; it usually involves how the model adjusts parameters based on new data during training to improve model performance.
advanced_config_e: Number of Samples Generated per Model Response Group
advanced_config_e_desc: A model response group is defined as the result set output by the model each time; a 50-character description length ensures information completeness and clarity.

correctness_bonus_a_desc:
Check if the model's answer is completely consistent with the standard answer (exact string comparison).
Notes: (1) No regular expression filled in: The system will compare the model's full response with the answer. (2) Regular expression filled in: The system will first extract key information from the response using the regular expression and only compare the extracted content with the answer.
correctness_bonus_b_desc:
Check if the numerical value of the model's answer is equal to that of the standard answer (e.g., 1.0 equals 1).
Notes: (1) No regular expression filled in: The system will attempt to parse the model's full response into a number for comparison. (2) Regular expression filled in: The system will first extract specific numerical values from the response using the regular expression before performing the comparison.
